{{Quote|General Syndulla, I'm sure we are all grateful for your service and role in restoring the Republic. Now we, as Senators, serve the people of that Republic and I can tell you they want no part of any further conflict.|Mawood, to [[Hera Syndulla]]|<ref name="Part Three" />}}
'''Lorrin Mawood'''<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> was a [[Human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Senator]] who was active during the [[New Republic Era]] and [[Ahsoka Tano]]'s [[Quest to find Ezra Bridger|search for Ezra]].<ref name="Part Three" />

In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Ahsoka series date">{{AhsokaSeriesDate}}</ref> Mawood was present in a meeting via [[hologram]] alongside New Republic [[Chancellor (New Republic)|Chancellor]] [[Mon Mothma]] and senators [[Rodrigo]], [[Hamato Xiono]] and a [[Gran]] [[Unidentified Gran senator|senator]], during which the group would discuss a report from [[General]] [[Hera Syndulla]].<ref name="Part Three" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mawood appeared via a hologram in "[[Part Three: Time to Fly]]",<ref name="Part Three" /> the third episode of the live-action [[Star Wars: Ahsoka|''Ahsoka'' television series]] which premiered on [[Disney+]] on [[August 29]], [[2023]].<ref name="Date">{{SW|url=news/ahsoka-premiere-date|text=''Ahsoka'' Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> Though his name is not said in the episode, it is provided in the credits. He was portrayed by actor [[Maurice Irvin]].<ref name="Part Three" />
